# GlobalDiscoveryService

- Namespace: `PPDS.Auth.Discovery`
- Assembly: `PPDS.Auth`
- Kind: Class
- Implements: `IGlobalDiscoveryService`, `IDisposable`

## Summary

Service for discovering Dataverse environments via the Global Discovery Service.
